name: resistive_hinge_overloads_fixed_arc
hypothesis: Elevated continuous hinge friction opposes both opening and closing without introducing a latch or spring-back fault. The fixed joint trajectory must transmit additional torque through the pull-bar grasp, potentially causing grasp migration or incomplete closure despite a successful opening.
expected_failure: Step 2 fails to reach 85 degrees, or step 8 loses handle engagement and leaves the door outside its one-degree closure tolerance.
real_world_story: A sticky gasket and dirty hinge make the dishwasher door noticeably harder to move.
